provenance.numerics: byte-copied from cases/validation/onera_m6_B_flin2, validated against AGARD AR-138 run 308
provenance.bc_types: M6 types re-expressed on ARGUS patch names (symm->symmetry, Back->outboard, topAndBottom->topBottom)

scale_resolution.ISSUE: the cruise condition is defined at AIRCRAFT scale (chord 3.196 m, b 38.36 m); geometry/derived/wing3d/*.stl is MODEL scale (half-span 1.8254 m, Cref 0.393957 m)
scale_resolution.CHOSEN: Re-match: model-scale geometry, mu adjusted so Re on Cref equals the aircraft-scale cruise Re. Same device the 2D transonic work already uses.
alternatives: scale the STL to aircraft size and use physical mu
run model scale at physical mu, which gives Re 1.9855e+06 and is a DIFFERENT flow
scale_resolution.NOTE: NOT ratified by a decision entry. This is the one modelling choice in this recipe without a ratifying project decision.

alpha.status: STARTING GUESS from the VSPAERO/VLM trim, NOT a RANS trim
alpha.action: trim each geometry to CL 0.54411480021 to |dCL| < 1e-4

reference_quantities.basis: DSO normalisation, Sref 1.24092 m2 / Cref 0.39396 m (project rules, hard fact 2); Aref is the HALF-wing value

limiter_variant.default: system/fvSchemes, cellLimited Gauss linear 1, as validated on the M6
limiter_variant.why: the limiter chatters on the ARGUS 2D mesh (7.55-count odd-even cycle) but the M6 keeps it and reproduces exactly. Detect, do not pre-emptively change: split Cd and residuals by iteration parity; two separated lines means switch to the variant.

layers.method: 0.026/Re^(1/7) flat-plate Cf, u_tau = U sqrt(Cf/2), y = yplus nu / u_tau
layers.RISK: first/surface = 11.5%, against a documented snappy floor near 8.4%. MUST be confirmed on a real mesh by reading the ACHIEVED layer thickness.
layers.ARG129_NOTE: ARG-129 rules y+80 incompatible with the 1.03 mm TE. That is a LOW-SPEED result (first layer 1.65x the surface cell). At cruise Re it is 0.09x and fits. The finding does not transfer; D077 shape.

mesh.levels: identical to L11_wallResolved_*; the surface cell is set by the 1.03 mm blunt TE, not by wall treatment or Reynolds (ARG-173)

layer_floor_test.question: does snappy build a first layer at ~9% of the local surface cell, or thicken it to its floor?
layer_floor_test.method: scale-invariant: every refinement level dropped by 2 and the first layer scaled by 4, so the first-layer-to-cell ratio is held at 8.95% at 1/16 the face count. Run on the real baseline_oml_placed_laddercap.stl, 12 ranks, laptop.
layer_floor_test.extrusion: 98.90% of faces extruded, 0 removed, 0 illegal faces
layer_floor_test.checkMesh: Mesh OK; max aspect 19.2, max non-orthogonality 68.5, max skewness 3.10
layer_floor_test.contrast: ARG-129 attempted y+80 at LOW SPEED and got 1.98 layers of 5 (40.5%) with 304,500 concave cells, because there the first layer is 1.65x the surface cell. At cruise Re it is 0.09x and builds.
layer_floor_test.CAVEAT: Run at 4x the production first-layer thickness with the RATIO held. This shows the ratio is buildable. If snappy's minimum has an ABSOLUTE component as well as a relative one, production could still differ. Only a production-resolution mesh settles that, which is what the cluster pre-flight is for.

measured_production_mesh.CORRECTION: SUPERSEDES the pre-run estimate of 27.3 M cells / ~102 GB carried in this file before the job ran. That estimate scaled the laptop level-9 layer cells by 16 and carried the background over unchanged, which under-counted the background refinement by more than a factor of two. LOAD-BEARING FOR: solve memory sizing and node count. A solve provisioned from the old number would be short by ~120 GB. The ARG-173 budget of 24.1 M / 90 GB is likewise superseded for THIS layer spec.
measured_production_mesh.layer_floor_verdict: CONFIRMED AT PRODUCTION RESOLUTION. The laptop scale-invariant test returned 97.4% of the requested stack and carried the caveat that snappy's minimum might have an ABSOLUTE component the ratio test could not see. It does not: the real mesh returns 99.6% with 4.96 of 5 layers and 0 illegal faces. The caveat is closed.
measured_production_mesh.wall_face_prediction: scaled from the level-9 laptop test as 5,290,000; measured 5,276,775, a 0.25% error. Also matches the L11 wall-RESOLVED mesh at 5,276,772, confirming ARG-173: the surface cell is set by the 1.03 mm blunt TE, not by wall treatment.
